findings.condition: tls.status == VALIDATED AND policyErrors == None AND 0 <= floor((notAfter - checkedAt)/day) <= 30 (legacy residual days only if dates unavailable)
http.status == OK AND normal page response AND valid HSTS grammar AND maxAge > 0
http.status == OK AND normal page response AND (HSTS explicitly absent OR valid maxAge == 0)
http.status == OK AND normal page response AND enforcing CSP explicitly null
http.status == OK AND normal page response AND enforcing CSP has recognized restriction directive; presence only
http.status == OK AND normal page response AND known XFO/CSP evidence shows no recognized embedding restriction (including explicit wildcard); ambiguous syntax stays internal
dns.spf.lookupStatus == FOUND AND one SPF record passes basic syntax checks AND first all is not permissive; presence only
dns.dmarc.lookupStatus == FOUND AND recordCount == 1 AND effectivePolicy (legacy input: tags.p) == none
dns.dmarc.lookupStatus == FOUND AND recordCount == 1 AND effectivePolicy (legacy input: tags.p) in [quarantine,reject] AND test mode absent or n
normal OK response AND explicit malformed HSTS field
normal OK response AND explicit CSP field without recognizable restriction
one SPF record passes basic syntax check AND first all is +all or all
one SPF record has obvious basic syntax problem
dns.dmarc.lookupStatus == FOUND AND recordCount == 1 AND effectivePolicy in [quarantine,reject] AND tags.t == y

guards: Only infer header absence when http.status == OK and the named header is explicitly null.
Unknown, error, missing field, malformed record, and unrecognized enum values yield INTERNAL_ONLY; never CONFIRMED.
TLS_EXPIRING is additional to TLS_VALID; do not count them as independent overall security scores.
Do not claim CSP presence establishes an effective policy.
SPF and DMARC validity are not proven by presence; basic syntax-only findings must say so.
Use checkedAt from input, not current system time, for reproducible output.
Raw HTML and user-supplied fields must be escaped.
All network operations are prohibited in evaluate and render.
Live DMARC absence requires completed bounded DNS policy discovery; transient DNS errors and invalid/ambiguous records are INTERNAL_ONLY. Legacy offline inputs are evaluated as originally supplied.
SPF evidence identifies the actually queried domain and does not imply inheritance or real SMTP sender authentication.
Do not conflate missing/invalid field types with explicit null. Non-normal HTTP responses do not produce page-header findings; no redirect is followed.
Known certificate-verification errors from the pinned destination may yield TLS_INVALID without HTTP acquisition; all other transport/security failures remain unavailable.
Frame evidence is evaluated independently of CSP presence; ambiguous source lists are not claimed safe.
SPF ancestor discovery is bounded and independently queried; do not infer company ownership or SMTP identity. Known PSD SPF excluded. Basic syntax and first all only, no recursive SPF verification.
Explicit malformed fields with a defined review finding are distinguished from unknown evidence.

DMARC t=y requests one level less than declared policy (RFC 9989 section 4.7); t=y with none remains DMARC_NONE, invalid test value stays internal only. Do not claim actual recipient behavior. Customer presentation snapshot is generated only for confirmed findings, not raw DNS/header text.
